transitions.note: by hand, or last order closed

cards.title: What triggers each step
items: AR sent: automatic when an AR to an LPS Partner is published; for other suppliers, Rosie records it once the link email is sent
Order created: ordering a job's selected candidates from a supplier sets Committed, so a Quote job can skip Availability
Closed as Won: set by hand, or automatic when the job's last open order closes and at least one of its orders was won
Closed as Lost: set by hand, or automatic on that last close when none of the job's orders was won

cards.title: Automatic steps only move forward
items: Sending an AR moves only a Quote job to Availability
Creating an order moves only Quote or Availability jobs to Committed
A legacy customer_confirmed event would do the same, but Rosie never sends it
Nothing automatic changes a Won, Lost, Archived or deleted job

cards.title: Manual override
items: An admin can pick any of the five stages from the job's status pill
Archived cannot be picked; it only appears on old records
Rosie's guidance: Committed comes from order creation, never by hand

cards.title: When a job ends
items: Won, Lost or Archived closes every AR of the job and revokes its public link
Deleting the job deletes its lines, candidates, ARs and orders
Closed jobs refuse new orders and AR publishing
Reopening a job reopens its chat thread, but never its ARs
